protocol_expansion.reason: A final outcome-blind pre-start dependency audit found that v4f referenced the earlier v3 history dataset and did not load a frozen learned model. A second timing audit found that fixed 25-row upstream pagination makes the completion time unknowable from request-group counts. This template materializes a dated v4g campaign only after the complete v4 acquisition, count gate, evaluation, independent audit, and content-bound probability model pass.

protocol_notes.primary_scope: Read-only 50-target, thirteen-station shadow validation on public SatNOGS observations; no jobs are submitted.
protocol_notes.historical_training: Every plan loads the completed v4 normalized cohort and its content-bound frozen model; absence or failure of any historical gate prevents campaign materialization and ledger initialization.
protocol_notes.external_satellites: Eight of the fifty prospective targets are absent from the fifty-satellite historical training cohort, providing a genuinely unseen-target operational subset in addition to the preregistered historical satellite holdout.
protocol_notes.station_selection: The ten-station band-complete set plus three connected, available, non-testing backup stations chosen outcome-blind by deterministic frequency multicover with at least 10,000 prior observations.
protocol_notes.availability: Every fetch records current Network station details. Disconnected or unavailable stations are excluded for that solve; the solve still fails unless every registered target receives an assignment.
protocol_notes.target_selection: The unchanged fifty outcome-blind, count-stratified transmitter targets with a retrievable pre-start CelesTrak TLE.
protocol_notes.frequency_coverage: Frozen exact SatNOGS antenna declarations provide at least two compatible campaign stations for the selected transmitter frequency of every target and act as hard feasibility constraints.
protocol_notes.target_coverage: Every daily plan must contain at least one assignment for every registered target; remaining receiver time maximizes expected successfully decoded unique samples.
protocol_notes.continuous_visibility: Allowed visibility intervals longer than 900 seconds are divided into contiguous, independently selectable sessions with source-pass lineage; no geometry is invented between SGP4 samples.
protocol_notes.weather: Forecast-aligned Open-Meteo Historical Forecast and GFZ Kp records participate only through the frozen model family selected by the preregistered held-out gate. Prospective Open-Meteo and NOAA bodies are frozen before each solve; terrestrial weather is used by the probability model only if that gate selected a weather-capable family.
protocol_notes.space_weather: NOAA SWPC Kp is active when available; missing future intervals stay explicitly missing.
protocol_notes.hardware: Current SatNOGS antenna identities and frequency ranges are real hard constraints with hash-bound raw responses. Gain and receiver-noise fields remain explicitly missing unless supplied by a measured, time-valid local archive.
protocol_notes.missingness: Every optional physical feature may be absent. The trained encoder uses explicit missing indicators; missing values reduce available information but never prevent a prediction.
protocol_notes.causal_boundary: A shadow run tests calibration, robustness and operational scheduling at scale, not causal yield improvement from executed recommendations.
